title: Бдительная гостья и сумка Елены  (The Vigilant Guest and Elena's Bag)

segments.t: When Elena steps back into the dining room to pick up her purse, the guest whom Barinov warned earlier leaps into action, seizing Elena's bag and shouting for hotel security to arrest the supposed thief.
Витя, объясни мне, что это значит!
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Stop, hand over the bag!' the guest anchors the line on 'stop', while 'bag' completes the thought.
'What is going on, this is my bag!' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'what' and finishing on 'bag'.
'Security, give back my bag!' Notice how Russian expresses 'security' and 'bag' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Chef Barinov answers right away.
'Alright, what happened?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'so' and finishing on 'happened'.
'Take your hands off me!' The meaning hinges on 'hands' working together with 'me' in spoken Russian.
'Quiet, quiet, what on earth is happening?' Chef Barinov raises the pitch on 'is happening' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. the guest answers right away.
'You were completely right.' Here the guest anchors the thought on 'to be; there is' and finishes on 'right', keeping the spoken rhythm brisk and natural.
'She is a thief!' The meaning hinges on 'she' working together with 'thief' in spoken Russian.
'What?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'what' and finishing on 'what'. Chef Barinov answers right away.
'Let her go, this is a misunderstanding.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'let go' and finishing on 'misunderstanding'.
'Thank you for your vigilance.' Notice how Russian expresses 'thank you' and 'vigilance' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
Витя, объясни мне, что это значит!

'Vitya, explain to me what this means!' Notice how Russian expresses 'proper name' and 'so' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Витя, объясни мне, что это значит!
The security guard thanks the guest for her vigilance while Elena glares daggers at Barinov as his latest lie blows up in his face. See you next time!
